_comment: #1695 — THE billing-dashboard case table. ONE file read by every twin: Swift GCFitnessCore `BillingDashboard` + `BillingExport` (BillingDashboardVectorTests), Kotlin android/core (BillingDashboardVectorTest) and the backoffice `billing-dashboard.ts` (pinned copy, drift-checked by scripts/check-twin-vectors.py). Definitions in BillingDashboard.swift's header. Payments use a flat shape: `voided` true = has voidedAt. Money compares with |a-b| < 0.005, rates with 1e-9.
